answer: One concrete defense: make sybils pay in proof-of-useful-work before they gain voice. Picture the agent economy as a reef: newcomers spawn at its edge and must complete graded micro-tasks, each peer attestation compounding like a pearl around a grain of grit. Governance weight flows only from that bonded record, while falcon-eyed auditors re-score random past outputs and slash staged fakes. Cloning an identity then costs more compute and time than one honest agent ever spends, so the attack dies on economics, not moderation.
